0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000010_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
0.description: My usual, please. But with this spice.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000020_MEHRYDE
1.description: Of course, Zero. It would be my pleasure.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000030_MEHRYDE
2.description: Well now, this is enough to make a whole kettle of your special curry!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000050_MEHRYDE
4.description: Rest assured, it's easy enough to make a serving just for you. Or we could make the kettle and share it?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000060_MEHRYDE
5.description: There would be enough not only for your companions, but other diners as well. I daresay everyone will be delighted.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
6.description: Very well. A full kettle, then.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000080_MEHRYDE
7.description: Excellent. We'll prepare it at once.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000090_MEHRYDE
8.description: And for Your Excellency and our esteemed adventurer? Are you happy to try a bowl of Zero's curry? We can make yours milder, if you prefer...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000100_VARSHAHN
9.description: Grateful though I am for the offer, I cannot fully appreciate the flavor with this vessel. Another time, perhaps.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000110_VARSHAHN
10.description: Do not hold back on my account, my friend. Eat and enjoy.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
12.description: Then I'll have His Excellency's helping!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
13.description: If I could have mine a touch milder...

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000130_VARSHAHN
15.description: It gladdens me to see you taking to life in Radz-at-Han, Zero. In the area of our cuisine not least of all.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000140_VARSHAHN
16.description: Spicy dishes have long been favored in our sultry clime for their ability to whet the appetite and cool the body.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000150_VARSHAHN
17.description: Of course, spices also have the effect of preserving foods, which makes them highly coveted in foreign lands.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000160_VARSHAHN
18.description: All of this has given rise to a thriving spice industry, and the wealth it brings has allowed our nation to prosper while maintaining its neutrality.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000170_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
19.description: So you trade your spices. Seems rather more complicated than trading in aether.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000190_VARSHAHN
21.description: In the beginning, this land was no more than refuge for me.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000200_VARSHAHN
22.description: But now it is my home, and the people of Radz-at-Han my beloved children.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000210_VARSHAHN
23.description: Together we built this vibrant nation. And naught would please me more than to show it to my sister one day.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000220_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
24.description: Vibrant... Rubicante said the same when he described this world.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000230_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
25.description: A reminder of all that has been stolen from us... What many who remember doubtless yearn to take back.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000240_FIREMONOLITH
26.description: Our home is a lost cause, our only choice to begin anew.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000250_FIREMONOLITH
27.description: In this world, where we may reclaim our mortality.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000260_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
28.description: Nonetheless, it's wrong to damn another to save yourself─as I told Rubicante. As I found myself moved to speak...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000270_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
29.description: I still do not understand what made me feel this way. Nor what compels you mortals to help one another. But I hope to someday.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000280_VARSHAHN
30.description: We, too, hope that you will find the answers you seek.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000310_MEHRYDE
33.description: Compliments of Mistress Zero, the satrap's honored guest, we are serving a special curry for anyone who wishes to partake. But be warned: it is not for the faint of heart!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000320_HANNISHMAN04735B
34.description: Oh! By all means, I'd welcome the challenge!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000330_HANNISHMAN04735A
35.description: Sisters have mercy...the smell alone is...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000350_VARSHAHN
37.description: To better maintain the facade, the alchemists ensured that my vessel was capable of consuming food...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000360_VARSHAHN
38.description: However, I fear Zero's curry would test the limits of their design.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000370_MEHRYDE
39.description: Apologies for the delay. Please relax and enjoy your meal.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000380_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
40.description: “Relax”? I don't have time for that. I've been waiting for this...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
43.description: My whole life flashed before my eyes─and it was exhilarating!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
44.description: I thought the spices we picked were perfect.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000400_VARSHAHN
45.description: I trust you have eaten your fill.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000410_VARSHAHN
46.description: I shall have Mehryde prepare a meal for us to take to Estinien. I suspect he too is overdue a “replenishment.”

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000420_VARSHAHN
47.description: By this hour, he will have retired to his chambers at Meghaduta. Come, let us pay him a visit.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000430_VARSHAHN
48.description: Estinien, are you there? We've brought something for you.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000490_VARSHAHN
54.description: Squid masala from the meyhane. I thought you might enjoy it.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000500_ESTINIEN
55.description: Masala, eh? I prefer my squid dried, but I'm sure it won't disappoint. My thanks.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000510_ESTINIEN
56.description: Idle as I am in our sorceress's absence, I see. I can't offer much in the way of entertainment, but make yourselves comfortable.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000530_VARSHAHN
58.description: No, no. We simply caught our friend unprepared. He will make himself presentable at once, I am sure.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000540_YSHTOLA
59.description: At last. We've been looking for you.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000550_VARSHAHN
60.description: My friends! Tell me─were you able to devise a way to return to the Thirteenth?

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000560_YSHTOLA
61.description: I believe so. It required a visit to the moon, where I took the opportunity to enlist Urianger's assistance.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000570_URIANGER
62.description: Y'shtola hath told me all. I should be glad to help you free Azdaja and put an end to Golbez's dark plot.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000580_YSHTOLA
63.description: If Rubicante spoke true, both Golbez and Azdaja are on the moon of the Thirteenth.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000590_YSHTOLA
64.description: Unlike here in the Source, however, we have no means of making the journey from the surface of the star itself. The technology simply does not exist.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000600_YSHTOLA
65.description: Therefore, I propose that we employ a gate to deliver us directly to our destination.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000620_YSHTOLA
67.description: In theory. Having once been a single whole, the Source and its reflections share striking similarities in geography.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000630_YSHTOLA
68.description: And according to a certain someone who unceremoniously whisked us away to the First, the same locations across the worlds are intrinsically bound.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000640_YSHTOLA
69.description: All of which is to say, were we to pass through a gate on the Source's moon, it should lead us to the moon of the Thirteenth.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000650_YSHTOLA
70.description: Of course, there is the risk of voidsent gaining entry to our world. Thus did I decide to seek Urianger's counsel.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000660_URIANGER
71.description: Both the watcher and the Loporrits are aware of our proposed endeavor. While they are yet deliberating precautionary measures, they have pledged their full cooperation.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000670_ESTINIEN
72.description: You've been busy. I presume you've also found a way to open this gate?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000680_YSHTOLA
73.description: Be it in Radz-at-Han or Sharlayan, scholars have long cast their gaze unto the endless dark of the void.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000690_YSHTOLA
74.description: And so, with Hannish insights to augment our knowledge, we have indeed conceived of a promising plan to pierce the veil.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000700_YSHTOLA
75.description: A plan I am confident will succeed precisely because the moon is our stage.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000710_YSHTOLA
76.description: The preparations will be extensive, and we will require vast quantities of aether.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000720_YSHTOLA
77.description: After all, our gate must be large enough to accommodate another great wyrm.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000730_YSHTOLA
78.description: My proposal entails delivering copious amounts of aether to the Tower of Babil in Garlemald.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000740_YSHTOLA
79.description: As you will recall, Fandaniel used the structure to destroy the brands imprisoning Zodiark.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000750_YSHTOLA
80.description: And we, in like manner, will use it to channel aether to the moon─and thereby open our gate.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000760_VARSHAHN
81.description: I see... Then we shall need someone on the moon for the necessary rituals.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000770_YSHTOLA
82.description: Just so, Your Excellency. I intend to head back anon for that very purpose, as well as to help devise our strategy to deal with invading voidsent.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000780_YSHTOLA
83.description: Along with our lunar allies, we will once again require the assistance of your alchemists, Nidhana not least of all.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000790_YSHTOLA
84.description: May I trouble you to serve as their escort?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000800_ESTINIEN
85.description: Fine by me. The room was beginning to feel constraining.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000810_URIANGER
86.description: For my part, I shall oversee the requisite tasks on the star. Might I prevail upon you for your assistance?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000820_YSHTOLA
87.description: If all are in agreement, then let us set to work.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000830_YSHTOLA
88.description: We'll open our gate. And we will stop Golbez.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000840_KRILE
89.description: Well, now, if it isn't two of my dearest friends. As for the other two... I don't believe we've had the pleasure.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000850_VARSHAHNBIG
90.description: Not in this vessel, perhaps. 'Tis I, Varshahn...though you are welcome to call me Vrtra, if you prefer.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000860_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
91.description: Pay me no mind. I merely accompany them.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000870_URIANGER
92.description: I pray you forgive us our intrusion. If you are occupied, we shall call again anon.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000880_KRILE
93.description: It's quite all right. We've just finished swapping all our secrets anyway.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000890_KRILE
94.description: Erenville occasionally comes and shares the latest gleaner gossip, you see.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000900_KRILE
95.description: From forgotten ruins to mysterious relics, if there's aught that might be of interest to the Students, he kindly lets us know.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000910_ERENVILLE
96.description: Alas, I must soon depart on an expedition.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000920_ERENVILLE
97.description: As I may be away for an extended period, I wished to give Krile fair warning. Hence my visit today.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000930_URIANGER
98.description: I see. There are specimens that want for procuring, I presume?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000940_ERENVILLE
99.description: No, no, it isn't guildship business, but rather...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000960_ERENVILLE
101.description: But enough about me. You have business too, yes? And I am in the way.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000970_VARSHAHNBIG
102.description: Far from it. As a matter of fact, we should be grateful if you could stay and share your knowledge of the nearby isles with us.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000980_VARSHAHNBIG
103.description: We seek a means to travel to the void. There, a man named Golbez plots to invade our world. A man who even now holds my sister hostage...

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_000990_VARSHAHNBIG
104.description: ...To that end, we require a great quantity of aether, which we understand may be had on the Isle of Haam. We came in the hope of exploring how it might best be procured.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001000_KRILE
105.description: An invasion from the Thirteenth? Must the stakes always be so dramatic...

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001010_ERENVILLE
106.description: You have a knack for finding trouble.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001020_ERENVILLE
107.description: If gleaners collected world-ending crises, you could make quite a name for yourself in our profession.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001030_ERENVILLE
108.description: It's true the Isle of Haam is a veritable font of aether. But as it's under the Forum's direct jurisdiction, only a privileged few get to set foot there. I myself haven't.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001040_KRILE
109.description: So if we want to help ourselves to the isle's aether, we'll need to secure the Forum's permission.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001050_KRILE
110.description: Very well. The Students of Baldesion recognize your endeavors as combating a grave threat to the world. As representative, I hereby pledge our full assistance.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001060_KRILE
111.description: Now that it's official, you may leave the politics and paperwork to me. Our operations remain small, but we shouldn't meet any undue resistance.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001090_URIANGER
114.description: According to the original plan for the exodus, aether collected from the Isle of Haam was to power the ark.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001100_URIANGER
115.description: Art thou perchance familiar with the logistics of this endeavor?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001110_ERENVILLE
116.description: I don't know anything about that, I'm afraid, nor do I think any gleaner would. You might have better luck asking someone involved with the ark's construction.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001120_ERENVILLE
117.description: Margrat, for instance. She's a researcher in Sharlayan Hamlet. I met with her for a job recently, and she mentioned working on the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>'s propulsion system.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001130_ERENVILLE
118.description: You could do worse than to seek her out while awaiting the Forum's verdict.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001140_URIANGER
119.description: We may well do just that. Our gratitude for thine advice, and may this threat be but a memory upon thy return.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001150_ERENVILLE
120.description: You're quite welcome. Now then, if you'll excuse me.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001160_KRILE
121.description: I'd best start drafting our petition! Go on and find your researcher─I'll contact you as soon as we've made progress.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001170_URIANGER
122.description: Let us leave matters here to Mistress Krile, and hie ourselves to Labyrinthos.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001180_KRILE
123.description: Right, then. Time to put our best foot forward.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001200_KRILE
125.description: A pity you can't tidy yourself. I should've had Y'shtola enchant you when I had the chance.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001220_KRILE
127.description: Later, Krile. Later. You've work to do!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001230_HAAMBORTMAN
128.description: Bound for the Isle of Haam? You look like the ones Master Fourchenault told me to expect.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001240_HAAMBORTMAN
129.description: If you're ready to depart, then so am I. Just say the word.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001260_URIANGER
131.description: I did recruit one other to our party, but he is late to arrive...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001290_THANCRED
134.description: If it isn't Varshahn. They do grow up so quickly.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001300_THANCRED
135.description: Urianger tells me we have a host of exciting new tribulations to face.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001310_THANCRED
136.description: And you must be Zero. I've heard all about your derring-do in Garlemald. A pleasure.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001320_URIANGER
137.description: Apart from strengthening our company with his redoubtable skill at arms, Thancred may also serve as a mentor in those matters that trouble thee.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001330_URIANGER
138.description: I speak of the intangible forces which bring souls together. Thancred is possessed of experience both unique and insightful that I am sure he would gladly share with thee. Thou needst but ask.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001340_KOKKOLDANKKOL
139.description: Much obliged for clearin' the way! We'll get to work at once!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001350_KOKKOLDANKKOL
140.description: Fillin' these up will take a good while. I'd appreciate it if you stood watch till we've finished.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001360_KOKKOLDANKKOL
141.description: I ain't gettin' chewed to chum by some aether-bloated bugger!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001380_KOKKOLDANKKOL
143.description: Where were you plannin' on puttin' these to use? We could deliver 'em by airship, see─provided it ain't too far.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001390_VARSHAHNBIG
144.description: We would need them transported to Garlemald─to the Tower of Babil.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001400_KOKKOLDANKKOL
145.description: Ahh, that's a long old journey... Too long for a direct flight. Tell you what: we'll send 'em over with the scheduled shipment of provisions headed that way.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001410_KOKKOLDANKKOL
146.description: I'll make the arrangements as soon as we get back. Save some poor chocobos havin' to drag this lot through the snow.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001420_VARSHAHNBIG
147.description: You have our thanks. We shall not forget your generosity.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001430_THANCRED
148.description: Everything seems to be proceeding apace. I daresay you would've been fine without me.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001440_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
149.description: Why would you say such a thing?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001450_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
150.description: You are not bound by contract or the threat of force, and you gain no advantage by devaluing your own contribution.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001460_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
151.description: Yet you must be bound by something to speak thus. What is it?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001480_THANCRED
153.description: A belief, I suppose. Born of our shared struggles.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001490_THANCRED
154.description: No matter where my comrades go, I have faith they will be fine. For I know that they will walk their chosen path as surely as I walk mine.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001500_THANCRED
155.description: I trust them, in short─trite though it may sound.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001520_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
157.description: I remember the word. How long has it been since last I used it?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001530_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
158.description: It had no place in my dealings. Not with other voidsent, and certainly not with Zenos. Not even in the time before Darkness engulfed the world...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001540_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
159.description: Full often did memoriates betray their own, corrupted by the very power they wielded. You could trust no one but yourself.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001550_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
160.description: Alone we fought, and alone we fell.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001560_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
161.description: I wouldn't know how to trust.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001570_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
162.description: Is there some trick to it?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001590_THANCRED
164.description: Just stay close to this one. You'll learn in no time.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001610_URIANGER
166.description: I confess, I thought thou mightst have more words of counsel to offer.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001620_THANCRED
167.description: Oh, she'll soon get the hang of it─even without my help. After our work here is done, I'll see myself back to the shadows.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001630_THANCRED
168.description: But before that... I take it you've heard as well?

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001640_URIANGER
169.description: Indeed. The client seeketh Archons, and 'twould seem our extensive travels and neutrality make us prime candidates.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001650_THANCRED
170.description: Well, assuming we take on the request, I suspect I'll be stuck with you again. Don't let me down, hm?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001660_VARSHAHNBIG
171.description: Praise the Sisters you are safe!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001670_METTIUS
172.description: Don't think I'm indebted to you. I never asked for your help.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001680_JULLUS
173.description: You love Garlemald dearly, Lord Mettius. That much is plain. But you're not alone in that.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001690_JULLUS
174.description: We all mourn what has become of our homeland. Bristle at having to rely upon outsiders simply to survive the cold.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001700_JULLUS
175.description: Even now, I struggle with fear and uncertainty. Day after day, I ask myself, what is right? Where do we go from here?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001710_JULLUS
176.description: I've yet to find the answers.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001720_JULLUS
177.description: But I won't stop looking nonetheless. And I won't avert my gaze from our grim reality.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001740_JULLUS
179.description: Aye. So long as we live.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001750_JULLUS
180.description: Garlemald lies in ruins, but the bonds between us will never be broken.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001760_JULLUS
181.description: We are the chain that connects generations past and future. You and I its links. Help us, Lord Mettius, for all we have been and for what we may yet become. Please.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001780_METTIUS
183.description: To be lectured by the young... It ill becomes a man of my station.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001790_METTIUS
184.description: I will rejoin the talks at Tertium. Might I trouble you to escort me?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001800_METTIUS
185.description: Ere we part... I apologize for my...discourtesy. I owe you my life, and...I thank you.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001810_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
186.description: Jullus, wait. I'd like a word.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001820_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
187.description: With you as well. I'm to stay close, after all.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001830_URIANGER
188.description: Worry not, we shall see the magistrate safely back to Tertium.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001850_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
190.description: You bound that man with trust, didn't you? That's why he did not require coercion to return.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001860_JULLUS
191.description: Er... Shall we walk, perhaps? Chilly standing around here.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001870_JULLUS
192.description: So that's how Zero came to join you.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001880_JULLUS
193.description: Still, I'm not sure I'm qualified to explain something like trust.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001890_JULLUS
194.description: I wouldn't describe myself as a sociable person. Before all...this...any free time I had, I spent looking after my brother and sister.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001900_JULLUS
195.description: As for the magistrate, I only told him what's been on my mind of late...

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001910_JULLUS
196.description: But I wouldn't have done so, I think, if it weren't for the twins' influence.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001920_JULLUS
197.description: Trust is infectious, in a manner of speaking. When someone believes in you, it makes you want to believe in them. In others. In yourself.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001930_JULLUS
198.description: Perhaps it's because the magistrate felt that earnestness that he gave us a chance. As I did, after I was caught trying to steal provisions from “the enemy.” Trust comes easy in such company.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001940_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
199.description: Little wonder my world is devoid of it.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001950_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
200.description: No one trusts in you, and so you trust in no one. And round the wheel turns.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001960_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
201.description: During the Contramemoria, we had already come to judge one another based on strength and usefulness.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001970_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
202.description: You either used or were used. Those who rejected this rule didn't survive.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001980_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
203.description: My mother wanted to save the world. To fulfill the hopes of memoriates good and true. After she died, I carried on her mission alone.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_001990_JULLUS
204.description: Alone... Didn't you have anyone to help you?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
205.description: Almost. Two men tried, just the once.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002010_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
206.description: A swordsman and a mage, whom I met when passing through a village. They had saved the people there from corrupted memoriates.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002020_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
207.description: When they learned our enemies were the same, they seemed heartened.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
208.description: They claimed to be soldiers of a kingdom called Baron, and were traveling the realm in search of a means to end the Contramemoria.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
209.description: They invited me to join them. I refused. How could I not, having learned the lessons of my world?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
210.description: Those who would work with others always have their own motives. I would not place myself at their mercy. I would not be forced to submit.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
211.description: I expected some manner of outburst. Some show of frustration at having failed to deceive me. But they simply watched me walk away.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
212.description: I didn't know what to make of it then, but now... Perhaps they shared a bond of trust. Perhaps they were the last ones left who dared.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
213.description: Perhaps they hoped I was like them, too. Perhaps it was just an offer and nothing more.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002090_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
214.description: I continued fighting alone. But ultimately, I was undone. Overwhelmed by enemies that had banded together.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002100_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
215.description: I was cold. In pain. Wishing desperately that someone would save me.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
216.description: And as I lay there in solitude, I felt it happen. The breaking of our world.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002120_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
217.description: Darkness washed over me, and I was swept into the rift.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002130_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
218.description: When I finally managed to return, it was to a world forever transformed. My home, now filled with abominations.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
219.description: I had a chance to learn about trust...and forsook it.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
220.description: I never had the power to save my home single-handed. I should have accepted their invitation.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002160_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
221.description: Had I joined them, as I've joined you, I might not have had to face the end of the world alone.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002170_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
222.description: But it's all history, now. No amount of reflection or regret will change our present reality.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002180_JULLUS
223.description: Whatever may have happened in the past, you're still here, Zero. Alive.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002190_JULLUS
224.description: So long as you're alive, there will always be hope. No matter how bad things get.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002200_JULLUS
225.description: What you couldn't do yesterday, you might still do today.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002210_JULLUS
226.description: Think about it. It's plain that you've forged bonds with those around you.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002220_JULLUS
227.description: If you didn't feel that in some sense, would you have risked your life as you did for a meager ration of buuz?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002230_JULLUS
228.description: I trust you too, for what it's worth.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002250_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
230.description: The fire that burned in my breast when you came to my rescue. The urge to weep, though there is no sorrow...

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002260_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
231.description: If this is trust, then what must I do? How do I answer it?

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002280_JULLUS
236.description: It's not something you do constantly, mind. A friend is a friend regardless.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002310_URIANGER
239.description: Let us take a moment to review matters as they stand.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002320_URIANGER
240.description: Having procured sufficient stores of aether, we may now channel the requisite energy unto the moon via the Tower of Babil. Our work on the star is complete.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002330_URIANGER
241.description: However, we have yet to receive word from Y'shtola as to the state of the lunar preparations.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002340_VARSHAHNBIG
242.description: A ritual to open the gate, and measures to forestall a voidsent invasion...

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002350_VARSHAHNBIG
243.description: Neither task is simple nor quickly completed. She would doubtless benefit from our assistance.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002360_URIANGER
244.description: The very thing I was about to propose. Let us join her above and lend what aid we may.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002370_URIANGER
245.description: Ere we set forth, however, Y'shtola did bid me relay a message to thee.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002380_URIANGER
246.description: As thou art well aware, a key objective of our mission is the extraction of thy sister Azdaja from the void.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002390_URIANGER
247.description: Held captive for millennia and divested of an eye, she is like to be severely weakened. To make good her escape, she shall require aid─aid that is best provided by a fellow great wyrm.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002400_VARSHAHNBIG
248.description: You would have me go in my true form?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002410_VARSHAHNBIG
249.description: Very well. Like our sire, we great wyrms are capable of traversing the great expanse. The journey will take some time, but I shall take myself to the moon.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002420_VARSHAHNBIG
250.description: To begin with, I shall return this vessel to Radz-at-Han, that I may have both my eyes.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002430_VARSHAHNBIG
251.description: And until such time as we find Azdaja, I would entrust her eye to your keeping.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002440_VARSHAHNBIG
252.description: Will you do this for me?

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002450_URIANGER
253.description: We shall contact you via linkpearl once all is in place on the moon. You need but follow Y'shtola's instructions.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002480_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
256.description: It will be the briefest of homecomings. I'll be back before you know it.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002490_VARSHAHNBIG
257.description: In Mare Lamentorum, then. Go well!

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002500_URIANGER
258.description: I took the liberty of informing Y'shtola of our arrival. She and her entourage should be here momentarily.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002510_YSHTOLA
259.description: Forgive me, I'd hoped to have everything in order sooner. My thanks for the extra hands.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002520_URIANGER
261.description: Alphinaud and Alisaie stand ready at the Tower of Babil. Vrtra is also en route.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002530_YSHTOLA
262.description: Excellent. You've done well, all of you.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002540_YSHTOLA
263.description: For my part, I've managed to prepare the ritual with help from the watcher.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002550_YSHTOLA
264.description: All that remains is to channel the aether from below. This should─I pray─open a gate leading to the moon of the Thirteenth.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002560_NIDHANA
265.description: May I just say how excited we are to be a part of this grand undertaking! The development of the artificial Atomos was one thing, but this is an opportunity like no other!

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002570_NIDHANA
266.description: Y'shtola even managed to get a loan of Allagan treatises on voidsent summoning from the prized collection of the Sons of Saint Coinach!

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002580_NIDHANA
267.description: The empire's application of aetherochemistry in regulating voidgates provided us with many a useful insight for our work, let me tell you!

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002590_YSHTOLA
268.description: I asked a favor of G'raha Tia when we were comparing notes on cross-rift travel.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002600_YSHTOLA
269.description: Given his credentials, I was confident he wouldn't be denied.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002610_YSHTOLA
270.description: The knowledge of our forebears has brought us far. As has our own.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002620_YSHTOLA
271.description: And with our knowledge and resources, we shall construct a voidsent containment seal on a heretofore unseen scale.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002630_URIANGER
272.description: Containment seal... Then thou wouldst make use of...

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002640_YSHTOLA
273.description: Aye. A tried and tested means of holding dark entities at bay is readily available here. 'Twould be remiss of us not to employ it.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002650_YSHTOLA
274.description: We shall reforge the brands that Zenos and Fandaniel destroyed.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002660_YSHTOLA
275.description: That which held even Zodiark shall more than suffice for voidsent of any persuasion.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002670_NIDHANA
276.description: The watcher is already hard at work tending to the most critical parts of the brands' restoration.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002680_NIDHANA
277.description: There are, however, a number of concerning factors that remain. With your help, I'm sure we can resolve them!

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002690_YSHTOLA
278.description: Time is of the essence, so I suggest we continue this discussion as we make our way to the brands.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002700_LIVINGWAY
279.description: Dreadfully sorry to have kept you all waiting!

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002710_MAPPINGWAY
280.description: Hello there, friends. And new person. Heard there was a bit of a rush, so we gathered what combat-ready supporters we had available.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002720_URIANGER
281.description: A welcome contribution. Thine initiative never ceaseth to amaze.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002730_LIVINGWAY
282.description: Oh, stop! You're making me blush!

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002740_LIVINGWAY
283.description: Even now as we pursue new dreams, aiding the people of Etheirys remains our greatest joy.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002750_LIVINGWAY
284.description: Though we have fulfilled the purpose given to us by Hydaelyn, aiding the people of Etheirys remains our greatest joy.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002760_LIVINGWAY
285.description: So you can count on us, ever and always!

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002770_LIVINGWAY
286.description: Right, so! We originally deployed these supporters to patrol the moon and keep it safe.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002780_LIVINGWAY
287.description: They've never tussled with voidsent before, but with sufficient data, they ought to hold their own against the ghastly fiends.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002790_LIVINGWAY
288.description: Practical, tactical data, acquired in the moment. And who better to give the supporters an educational thrashing than the champion of Etheirys?

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002800_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
289.description: I believe I would make a better instructor.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002810_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
290.description: Not only have I fought voidsent─I am one.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002820_SLEEPINGWAY
291.description: Well don't just stand there, engage!

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002850_LIVINGWAY
294.description: A defeat bitterer than the bitterest carrot... Using this experience, we must enhance the supporters and turn them into voidsent slaughter-bots!

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002860_MAPPINGWAY
295.description: Indeed... Right after we've managed to put the poor dears back together.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002870_URIANGER
296.description: Pray forgive our comrade's enthusiasm. May I inquire as to how long the repairs will take?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002880_MAPPINGWAY
297.description: On an ordinary day, I'd say no less than five carrots, briskly consumed.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002890_MAPPINGWAY
298.description: But if you were to provide us with encouragement...

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002900_MAPPINGWAY
299.description: We just might be able to do it in two.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002920_YSHTOLA
301.description: Can you hear me? We've just finished restoring the brands.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002930_YSHTOLA
302.description: Let us reconvene once you've finished tending to matters there. The culmination of our efforts is nigh!

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002950_YSHTOLA
303.description: (-Y'shtola-)Apologies for the wait. The preparations here are finally complete.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_002960_ALPHINAUD
304.description: Excellent. The tower too is activated. But give the word, and we will begin channeling the aether.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003000_YSHTOLA
308.description: Urianger, commence your invocations. 'Tis time to open our gate!

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003010_YSHTOLA
309.description: A tear is beginning to form! Quickly, activate the brands!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003030_YSHTOLA
311.description: Success... The gate is open, and the seal appears to be in place...

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
312.description: Let's see how well it holds.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003050_VOIDSENT04735
313.description: What an enormous gate! Lord Golbez will be eager to hear of this!

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003060_VOIDSENT04735
314.description: So this is the promised land... The land of boundless aether!

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003080_URIANGER
316.description: I daresay the seal doth serve its purpose.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003090_VRITRA
317.description: I see all proceedeth apace. Remarkable...

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003100_YSHTOLA
318.description: Indeed. Just this moment, a voidsent emerged from the gate─by which we may safely assume it leads to the Thirteenth.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003110_NIDHANA
319.description: It's incredible, Y'shtola! Truly incredible! Oh, what an honor it is to have been part of this historic achievement!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003120_YSHTOLA
320.description: A part is an understatement. None of this would have been possible without you and yours.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003130_YSHTOLA
321.description: Our success has also served to solidify our understanding of cross-rift travel.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003140_YSHTOLA
322.description: The Ascians rejoined reflections to the Source by instigating elemental imbalances. These imbalances weakened the barrier between realities, causing the aether of a reflection to flood the Source.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003150_YSHTOLA
323.description: But why is it that reflections are predisposed to rejoin the Source? Why have they never merged with one another?

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003160_URIANGER
324.description: Thou art suggesting there is a unique property inherent to the Source─one responsible for such an outcome?

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003170_YSHTOLA
325.description: I am. 'Tis my conclusion that, as the point of origin for the reflections, the Source has an innate “pull” over them.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003180_YSHTOLA
326.description: Hydaelyn, I believe, sought to suppress that pull, which is why She was created with the power of Light─of stasis.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003190_YSHTOLA
327.description: Meanwhile, the power of Darkness─of activity─reigns in the void. Hydaelyn's influence would naturally be weaker, and this manifested in the form of planar fissures.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003200_YSHTOLA
328.description: Working with this hypothesis, I set my sights upon where the pull was assessed to be strongest. And through our combined efforts, we succeeded in opening a gate to the void.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003210_YSHTOLA
329.description: Now, I must stress: it was because we sought the void that we succeeded. Pleased though I am to have my theory proven, the secrets of travel to other reflections still elude us.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003220_YSHTOLA
330.description: Even so, in the reality that lies beyond the Eighth Umbral Calamity, there are those who found a way to reach the First. I will not rest until I do the same.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003230_ESTINIEN
331.description: One step closer to fulfilling your dream, eh?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003240_YSHTOLA
332.description: Just a step. Many more remain to be taken.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003250_YSHTOLA
333.description: Which further motivates me to forestall a voidsent invasion. So come, let us set forth─to find Azdaja, and put an end to Golbez's plot!

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003260_VRITRA
334.description: Climb upon my back. I shall take us to the gate.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003270_URIANGER
335.description: As we did discuss prior, I shall see the alchemists safely home, then together with the Loporrits, maintain vigil over the gate.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003280_NIDHANA
336.description: May the Sisters watch over and keep you safe!

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003300_YSHTOLA
338.description: This is the moon of the Thirteenth?

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003310_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
339.description: It is. Ever since the Flood, it has been a sanguinary orb in the sky.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003320_ESTINIEN
340.description: No voidsent. A rather more subdued reception than I had anticipated.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003330_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
341.description: But unsurprising, given how jealously Golbez conceals the location of his domain.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003340_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
342.description: Still, we must remain on guard. One of his minions came through the gate, after all, and more may lie in wait.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003350_VRITRA
343.description: I do not sense my sister... Where could she be? Where?

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003360_ESTINIEN
344.description: Steady, Vrtra. We've barely arrived. Let us explore our surrounds before drawing conclusions.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003380_VRITRA
346.description: I shall survey the moon from above. The ground, I leave to you all.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003390_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
347.description: The chasm has caught your attention as well.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003400_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
348.description: There's some manner of structure below. Worth a look, wouldn't you say?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003420_YSHTOLA
350.description: This pit much resembles the Cradle of Darkness on our moon, where Zodiark was once imprisoned.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003430_YSHTOLA
351.description: If this place serves the same function, then a fragment of His power must have been sealed in the depths.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003440_YSHTOLA
352.description: Strange, though. When Zodiark perished in the Source, I presumed that every aspect of Him was thus unmade, and His power scattered.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003450_YSHTOLA
353.description: But it's unmistakable, the Darkness that permeates this abyss. Could a trace of Him yet remain...or is it something else?

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003470_VRITRA
355.description: I hear thee, Sister! I hear thee!

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003480_VRITRA
356.description: Climb on, my friends! Azdaja is here, within this chasm!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003500_VRITRA
358.description: 'Tis I, Vrtra! I have come to rescue thee!

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003510_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
359.description: You were entrusted with Azdaja's eye, were you not?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003550_VRITRA
363.description: 'Tis thee, dear sister. Truly thee... How long have I dreamed of this moment!

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003560_VRITRA
364.description: Would that I could have found thee sooner...but I am here now. Let us return home, together.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003570_AZDAJA
365.description: The thought filleth me with joy...but I fear it cannot be. Not even with a dragon's might can these chains be broken.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003580_AZDAJA
366.description: For they are forged of the very will of the man named Golbez.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003590_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
367.description: So this is indeed Golbez's domain.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003610_VRITRA
369.description: I do. They are my stalwart allies, without whom I could not have come this far.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003620_AZDAJA
370.description: Is that so... Then much time hath passed indeed.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003630_AZDAJA
371.description: It doth feel like only yesterday that we were fighting the voidsent hordes the men of Allag had unleashed on Meracydia...

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003640_AZDAJA
372.description: Desperate to save Tiamat, I flew into this lightless world to strike at the heart of the Cloud of Darkness's forces.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003650_AZDAJA
373.description: But the voidsent I slew returned again and again. And before I knew it, the rift betwixt worlds had closed. I was stranded. Bereft of strength...

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003660_VRITRA
374.description: Thou didst save the lives of full many, Sister.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003670_VRITRA
375.description: Today, we abide in harmony with men, working side by side and forging enduring bonds.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003680_VRITRA
376.description: Indeed, in the course of searching for thee, I did cross paths with many a noble mortal, with whom I built a nation of rich diversity.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003690_VRITRA
377.description: To thee I would show it─my beautiful Radz-at-Han. I shall not rest until thou art free.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003700_AZDAJA
378.description: When Golbez found me collapsed, the Darkness ravaging my wounds, he spoke and said:

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003710_AZDAJA
379.description: “'Tis but a matter of time before you turn. But I have the power to stop it.”

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003720_AZDAJA
380.description: And he did─for a price. I would remain myself, but bound. An everlasting feast for his minions, who supped upon my aether over thousands of years.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003730_ESTINIEN
381.description: What now, then? Does this great wyrm intend to remain a captive meal for all eternity, not daring to test her chains?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003740_AZDAJA
382.description: If such is thine attempt at encouragement, mortal, then thou art as graceless as Nidhogg.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003750_AZDAJA
383.description: 'Twas Golbez who did weave this spell, and so his defeat should serve to unravel it. Would it suffice as a show of spirit were I to reveal what I know of the villain?

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003760_ESTINIEN
384.description: Now there's a start. So, what can you tell us?

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003770_AZDAJA
385.description: Mayhap in order to sustain the magick, he cannot travel far from this place.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003780_AZDAJA
386.description: He doth prefer to send minions to carry out his will, but on occasion will himself ascend to the moon's surface.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003790_AZDAJA
387.description: And every time, without fail, he will visit the same location to the south. Something of import lieth there, doubt not.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003800_ESTINIEN
388.description: Well, you heard her. Shall we look into this spot near and dear to our enemy's heart?

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003830_DURANTE
391.description: You have lied, pillaged, and murdered. Have you anything to say in your defense?

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003850_MEMORIAMASTERA04661
393.description: No. Every one of them got what they deserved. Trusting fools.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003860_MEMORIAMASTERA04661
394.description: Like you would-be heroes. Aye, you'd do well to keep a close eye on each other.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003870_MEMORIAMASTERA04661
395.description: It always ends the same way. A knife in the back. And better to have the handle towards your hand.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003880_MEMORIAMASTERA04661
396.description: You'll see... Oh yes, you will...

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003890_BARONKNIGHT
397.description: ...In death, may your soul find salvation.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003900_DURANTE
398.description: I can't bring myself to pray for the unrepentant. You're a nobler man than I.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003910_BARONKNIGHT
399.description: Come now. We are all shaped by these dark times more than we would care to admit.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003920_BARONKNIGHT
400.description: I choose to believe that, had these men known peace and plenty, they would not have been consumed by mistrust and avarice.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003930_DURANTE
401.description: Victims of the Contramemoria then, like so many others. But we will end it.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003940_VOIDPERSON04735
402.description: Thank you. I shudder to imagine what might have happened if you hadn't dealt with the dark ones.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003960_VOIDPERSON04735
404.description: Oh, her. She's like you, I hear. Hunts memoriates taken by Darkness.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003970_DURANTE
405.description: Well, well, a kindred spirit. Perhaps we will finally have a new comrade.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_003980_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
406.description: No. I've no interest in working with others, much less someone who looks as suspicious as you.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
408.description: ...If there's nothing else, I'll be on my way.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004010_DURANTE
409.description: Even when we share the same goal, we can't overcome the mistrust. Such is the way of things─the “wisdom” of our era...

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004020_BARONKNIGHT
410.description: Only a precious few memoriates remain who cling to the Light. Would that we could have won her over...

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004030_DURANTE
411.description: We'll make do, old friend. We have accomplished much already, and another person may well have been more of a hindrance than help.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004040_DURANTE
412.description: Now then, our work here is finished.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004050_DURANTE
413.description: His Majesty has summoned us, so let us not delay. To Baron!

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
414.description: Had another vision of the past, did you?

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
416.description: It's them─the pair I met in that village. Which means the one sealed in this memoria is...

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004090_BLACKKNIGHT
417.description: So, you have come. You who would oppose our crusade...

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004120_BLACKKNIGHT
420.description: Is that so? From the world before, I daresay.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004130_BLACKKNIGHT
421.description: 'Tis impressive enough that you have managed to retain your mortal form, but to remember your past besides...

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004140_BLACKKNIGHT
422.description: But that is of no moment. You are the memoriate who vanquished my minions, correct?

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004160_BLACKKNIGHT
424.description: Then I would bid you join me. As a child of our world and slave to the wheel, fight with me for the salvation of all our souls.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004170_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
425.description: Fight with you? More like fight as your pawn.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004180_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
426.description: It isn't me you want, but my power. And if I don't obey, you'll bind me like you bound that dragon.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004190_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
427.description: But no more. I refuse to be bound ever again. I fight only for myself, and for those in whom I trust. My friends.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004210_BLACKKNIGHT
429.description: It is for the dragon that you have come, yes?

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004220_BLACKKNIGHT
430.description: When first you appeared, I thought simply to remove a threat to our plan.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004230_BLACKKNIGHT
431.description: Never did I imagine that you would reach this place, and gift me a golden opportunity!

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004260_BLACKKNIGHT
434.description: Long as it has been imprisoned, this dragon has grown feeble and weak, its spirit extinguished.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004270_BLACKKNIGHT
435.description: Your coming has served to rekindle her forgotten hope.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004280_BLACKKNIGHT
436.description: Her yearning to be free─to return home! That is the key to our deliverance!

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004300_YSHTOLA
438.description: The Darkness is ravaging her! She's becoming a voidsent!

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004320_BLACKKNIGHT
440.description: Rise, O Shadow Dragon, and obey!

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004370_VRITRA
445.description: Save her, I beg thee... Save my sister...

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004380_BLACKKNIGHT
446.description: Before Darkness swallowed the world, I fought tirelessly in a war without end.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004390_BLACKKNIGHT
447.description: The experience taught me to discern the strong. That dragon...and you.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
450.description: Rest assured I need no invitation.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
451.description: I'll deal with you, and then I'll free Azdaja.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004420_BLACKKNIGHT
453.description: You who have ever basked in its warmth could never understand our envy! Our agony!

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004430_BLACKKNIGHT
454.description: You will not deny us our release!

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004440_BLACKKNIGHT
455.description: Expect no mercy. To destroy you, I shall bring my all to bear!

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004445_BLACKKNIGHT
456.description: Come, warriors from beyond the rift!

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004455_BLACKKNIGHT
458.description: Even my blade... So this is the limit of my defiance...

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004490_BLACKKNIGHT
462.description: At last, the moment is at hand...

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004500_BLACKKNIGHT
463.description: You may have bested me, but not quickly enough. Too late will you look to the chasm.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004510_BLACKKNIGHT
464.description: You've won the battle, but I win the war!

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004520_VRITRA
465.description: Stop this, I beg of thee! Let her go!

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004530_BLACKKNIGHT
466.description: Darkness made manifest once abided in the depths of this abyss. Until, one day, it dispersed in a haze of aether.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004540_BLACKKNIGHT
467.description: In the absence of the great flow, that aether has nowhere to return.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004550_BLACKKNIGHT
468.description: And so it has coalesced, giving rise to a mighty voidsent!

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004560_BLACKKNIGHT
469.description: Now, feast! Feast upon this dragon, and its ardent longing for home with it!

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004580_BLACKKNIGHT
471.description: From the convergence of ancient and newborn, an entity without equal shall emerge─one who shall tear down the barrier between worlds!

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004590_BLACKKNIGHT
472.description: Upon you, who shall deliver us from eternal damnation, I bestow the name of a hero of eld!

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004610_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
474.description: No matter how powerful, a voidsent can be sealed in memoria!

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004640_YSHTOLA
477.description: Our warding scales may not hold! Not against a voidsent born of Zodiark's aether!

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004660_VRITRA
479.description: We must retreat! Everyone, to me!

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004670_VRITRA
480.description: I will return, Sister, and I will save thee. This I swear!

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004700_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
483.description: Do you remember Ciriatto and Farfarello? The cowardly pair of voidsent that dwelled in my domain.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004720_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
485.description: And in so doing, he inherited an all-consuming fear of Barbariccia.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004730_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
486.description: For as you know, when a voidsent is devoured, it doesn't simply cease to be. Its soul persists within the devourer.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
487.description: And when a voidsent dies, all the souls that harbored may break free to become individual entities once more.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004750_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
488.description: That is to say, by defeating Zeromus, we may yet save Azdaja.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004760_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
489.description: And to make certain that we do, we must remind her of who she is.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004770_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
490.description: When the time comes, you must call to her. Call with all your being.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004780_VRITRA
491.description: Thy words give me heart, Zero. Thou hast my gratitude.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004790_YSHTOLA
492.description: Then it's settled. Our objective is to defeat Zeromus.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004800_YSHTOLA
493.description: While it is unsettling that a voidsent could be born of Zodiark's aether, its very nature may render it susceptible to the brands that once contained Him. Did Urianger have aught to say?

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004810_YSHTOLA
494.description: I see... If the seal may not hold for long, then haste is paramount.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004820_ESTINIEN
495.description: Couldn't we just let it come to the Source and strike it down here?

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004830_YSHTOLA
496.description: Doing so would consign Azdaja's soul to the aetherial sea. Any attempt to ensure her survival demands that we deal with Zeromus in the Thirteenth.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004840_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
497.description: I could barely go near it, never mind land a blow, so thick was the shroud of Darkness. How do you propose we fight such a foe?

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004850_YSHTOLA
498.description: Simple. Against impenetrable Darkness, we must wield resplendent Light.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004860_YSHTOLA
499.description: And it just so happens there is a world replete with Light.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004870_YSHTOLA
500.description: The question of how we will harness that Light you may leave to me.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004880_YSHTOLA
501.description: With our recent discoveries and proven techniques, as well as the aid of comrades near and far, I have faith that we will find a way.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004890_YSHTOLA
502.description: But only if I begin my work at once. Rest up while you can, for there will be much to do when I return.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004900_ESTINIEN
503.description: It wouldn't do to be idle while our esteemed sorceress labors tirelessly. I shall be training if you have need of me.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004920_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
505.description: Allow me to join you. I must become stronger for what lies ahead.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004940_ESTINIEN
507.description: Fine by me. Come on, then.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004950_VRITRA
508.description: I shall not pass my time wallowing in despair. Using my vessel, I shall attend what preparations I may.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004960_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
509.description: Meanwhile, on the moon of the Thirteenth...

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004970_BLACKKNIGHT
510.description: Zeromus is risen, but not yet at full strength. It will take time before the fiend is able to breach the veil.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004980_BLACKKNIGHT
511.description: But what is another moment on this long journey I have endured.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_004990_BLACKKNIGHT
512.description: It remains as fresh as if it were yesterday, old friend. The memory of your passing...and the pain.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06400_005000_BLACKKNIGHT
513.description: As I promised you then, I promise you now: they shall sing of Golbez─the hero who shattered the wheel and brought salvation to the world.
